profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Prime Therapeutics | Microservices | Agile | Java | AWS | Spring

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Enhancing application allowing prescribers to submit electronic prior authorization (ePA) requests for prescriptions

- Architected via AWS Serverless Framework, Java, Spring, MySQL
- Increased ePA adoption rate from 17% to 80% from 2022-2024
- Reduced ePA processing time by 40%
- Improved patient search accuracy from ~50% to ~98%
- Streamlined production deployments utilizing AWS Code Pipeline
- Expedited releases of new features and production defect repairs
- Optimized recovery efforts during AWS outages or service disruptions from external APIs
- Reduced overall production troubleshooting durations
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring REST · AWS Lambda · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) · AWS CodePipeline · Amazon SQS · Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) · Amazon S3 · AWS EC2 · Gradle · Agile Methodologies · Scrum · Jira · Amazon Dynamodb

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed dashboard displaying Colnack website visitor metrics along with all actions performed within 2 selected dates
- Implementing C++ system daemon for Ubuntu Linux that parses nginx logs, subsequently  
  generating JSON files with daily metrics regarding number of requests per action and user 
  respectively
- Metrics then aggregated and leveraged by web server to be implemented in a later stage

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
Conducted research on quantifying the diurnal cycle of cloud fraction in near-polar latitudes
- Calculated latitudinal, diurnal sampling density of Atmospheric Infrared Sounder(AIRS) version 6 level 2 data to determine if a diurnal cycle can be derived from a single polar-orbiting satellite
- Validated AIRS monthly mean diurnal cycles by comparing with derived monthly mean diurnal cycles from ground-based millimeter cloud radar/micropulse lidar and shortwave/longwave measurements from North Slope Alaska Atmospheric Radiation Measurement site

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Enhanced user experience for a web interface scientists access to locate data needed to test algorithms 
- Optimized queries via stored procedures on Oracle database
- Modernized front-end via CSS, Bootstrap, & AngularJS
- Streamlined overall search process for needed atmospheric data products

positions.title: Supplemental Instruction Leader (SI Leader)
positions.locationName: Los Angeles County, California, United States
positions.description: As a SI Leader for Cal State LA's College of Engineering, Computer Science, and Technology(ECST), I developed freshmen's abilities to solve rigorous pre-calculus problems. I also motivated students to share their knowledge with their peers and lend a helping hand. Miscellaneous advice about topics ranging from study habits, major requirements, to college expectations I also provided.

volunteerExperiences.description: Progfest is a programming competition that the computer science department at Cal State LA sponsors in which high school and community college students are invited to assemble into teams and finish 10 programming questions within a limited time span. The team with the most correctly answered questions receives a prize. As a proctor, I was responsible for monitoring activity of the contestants, assuring that no contestant was engaging in cheating.

projects.title: Using Artificial Intelligence to Diagnose Viral Infectious Disease (Thesis)
projects.description:
Developed predictive models via a set of Scikit-Learn classifiers (Random Forest & Support Vector 
Machine) to predict and diagnose viral infections for future patients
- Achieved best accuracy of 82.6% with Random Forest at 100 base estimators

projects.title: AT&T Machine Learning for Signal Quality Monitoring
projects.description:
Contributed to the UI of an Android app aiming to assist AT&T technicians; streamlining troubleshooting procedures for machinery failures at ground stations across the U.S.
-Developed front-end components for various pages of the app
-Connected the front-end components with incoming data from Java back-end web service

organizations.name: Association of Computing Machinery(ACM)
organizations.position: Freshman Representative, Historian, Secretary · Feb 2013 - Nov 2016
organizations.description:
As a freshman representative, I was in charge of the networking aspect for ACM. I, along with another representative, was in charge of keeping members up to date with events within our organization, as well as informing our fellow freshmen colleagues about our club.

As historian, I was in charge of photographing various events ACM held. From general meetings to the annually held Progfest, I provided photographs of ACM's activities and uploaded them to our Instagram page:  instagram.com/calstatela_acm. I also uploaded updates to our Facebook page: http://facebook.com/acm.calstatela

As secretary, I was in charge of keeping record of the agendas for our weekly meetings and sending emails regarding various events our organization sponsors.
